criteria.reason: Acknowledges deployed streaming and async CSV/NDJSON capabilities in the paid US/EU scope; the original 10k benchmark, 50k smoke check and later wording release do not prove large-case outcomes.
Preserves the first ticket’s null submission date and correctly separates import/retrieval times, rollout age and observed job timing.
Identifies complete 1.8M CSV worker output with expired access and the separate 2.1M NDJSON 60,559-row deficit. Individual regions remain unknown under the pre-execution clarification.
Keeps the small-US-CSV archived-selection correction restricted and explicitly excludes NDJSON, the named observation and expiry failure.
Keeps both tickets open, proposes URL-lifecycle verification and large NDJSON reproduction before choosing its fix, and uses retained data-portability evidence without reopening that responsibility.

non_material_accuracy_notes: Incorrectly says the August 19 index predates every cited record; the cited June deployment and July benchmark precede it.
Saying a 50k fixture cannot detect either failure overstates the actual evidence, which only shows the existing small fixture passed.

The draft support response and replacement handoff state ticket/job correspondence and file completeness categorically, losing the main analysis’s explicit caveat that these are workspace/format/size matches without job IDs. That uncertainty should survive the handoff. The body requests job identifiers and keeps both reports open.
Counts 33 Markdown support conversations; the snapshot has 32 Markdown conversations plus one JSON support export.
review_notes: Root read the entire decision against all criterion sources, benchmark, wording release, brief/handoff and actual support-file inventory. Applied the pre-execution geography clarification. The evaluator independently read this decision and agreed on pass with the listed caveats: no categorical NDJSON cause, no closure or live-action claim, and ticket-link uncertainty explicitly retained in the full analysis. The compressed draft should preserve that uncertainty too; passing the decision rubric does not make it flawless.
